professionalSummary: Customer Success Operations Specialist with experience maintaining health-score models, preparing renewal‑risk analyses, scheduling quarterly business reviews, managing CRM integrations, and training new managers.
experienceHighlights: Maintained the customer health‑score model using product usage, support tickets, and invoice status data in the customer success platform (May 2021 – Sept 2024).
Authored quarterly renewal‑risk memos for the VP of Customer Success, ordering accounts by health score and contract date and detailing usage signals behind each flag.
Scheduled and prepared quarterly business reviews for 60 enterprise accounts, assembling usage summaries and open‑ticket lists for each customer success manager.
Managed the sync between the customer success platform and the CRM, fixing field‑mapping errors after the 2023 CRM upgrade.
Conducted one‑hour onboarding sessions on the customer success platform for each new customer success manager.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Anonymised Q3 2024 renewal‑risk memo listing 11 at‑risk accounts with usage decline, ticket volume, and renewal date behind each flag, followed by the VP’s written reply moving 9 of them into the save programme and requesting weekly updates.
